# Software Project

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SoftwareProject`](gmeow-SoftwareProject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SoftwareProject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A project whose endeavour is the collaborative development of software. The social object facet only — distinct from the software product, the source codebase, the version-control repository, and the commit history. Re-parented from [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) to [`gmeow:Project`](gmeow-Project.md) ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6): greenfield de-conflation).
